page_title: FUL 0-0 EVE | Fulham v Everton 30/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Beto (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+6' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+5' James Garner (Everton) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
90+5' James Garner (Everton) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) comes onto the pitch because Arnaut Danjuma simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
90' The injury to Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
89' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
87' James Garner (Everton) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Bernd Leno has no trouble gathering it.
87' The free kick is taken by James Garner (Everton), but ball is cleared. Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a short corner kick.

84' Excellent touch by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
81' Here is a change. Ashley Young is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Patterson (Everton).
81' The substitution is prepared. Beto (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
78' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
77' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' It will be a substitution. Tim Ream (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Issa Diop walks off.

75' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
74' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
73' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jordan Pickford, who smothers the ball.
67' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) has a great chance to score, but he heads the ball onto the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
66' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to send the ball in.
66' He should have scored! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Fulham win a corner.
65' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

63' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) works the corner short.

62' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
62' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

61' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
60' Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
59' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

56' CHANCE! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
56' James Garner (Everton) will deliver the corner kick.

56' Ben Godfrey (Everton) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.

52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
52' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.

51' A lofted cross from Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.

50' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Silva probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Raul Jimenez (Fulham). He is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Everton fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.
45+1' A lofted pass picks out Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. Everton earn a corner.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
42' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) fails to score from close range. He picks up a rebound, but sends it wide of the target! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.

39' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
39' Willian (Fulham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

38' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Jordan Pickford comes off his line to intercept.
36' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

33' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
30' Willian (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
28' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Ben Godfrey (Everton) for his blatant foul.
28' Jack Harrison (Everton) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
27' Ashley Young (Everton) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Palhinha (Fulham) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' James Tarkowski (Everton) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the bar and ricochets away!
24' Ashley Young (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Bernd Leno to dive and make a save.
24' It seemed like Ashley Young (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

22' Andreas Pereira finds the head of Joao Palhinha (Fulham) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
16' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
16' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

10' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Jordan Pickford has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
8' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
6' Now Fulham have a corner.
5' Everton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
5' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Jack Harrison (Everton) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
2' Willian (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fulham will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
